#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Is everything alright, Annalie? You look sad…
Lady Annalie: Sorry. My guy friend got sick on the plane and they had to go to the hospital.
Bot: That’s horrible! What happened?
Lady Annalie: His stomach started to hurt all of a sudden. They will run some tests and tell me more when they can.
You: Is the show in danger? 
Lady Annalie: I was assured that she would come no matter what and I decided to believe her. 
You: Sure, no worries. Things like that happen and health takes the priority.
Lady Annalie: Yeah…
Lady Annalie: Sorry, I lost my mood for today. How about we cut this short and meet another time?
???: Oh? Do I hear trouble?
#Annalie_Outside.animate(MoveToLeft)
